name: bundle-budget
title: Cut the first-load payload and add a bundle budget gate
description: Attack the measured 4.48 MB raw / 1.52 MB gzip first load: import three on demand instead of the full build, assert the Vue dev build is gone, lazy-load Rapier with a self-hosted .wasm instead of the 2.86 MB base64-inlined jsDelivr bundle, evaluate baking Draco offline, and add scripts/check-bundle.mjs that fails the build when the first screen exceeds 450 KB gzip or the total exceeds 0.9 MB gzip. Acceptance: the gate runs from one command and a before/after table documents the win.
creator: HelongZhou
